g.text: At 7:00 - 8:00 NY am, Candle 2 is a bearish order block bcs candle 4 closed below the opening price of candle 2

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and candle 5 opening price is below the opening price of candle 2; and candle 5 closes below the close of candle 4.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: So you can sell short here.
